svg.title: Store every distance, or store the roads
svg.desc: Left: bars on a logarithmic scale comparing what each design stores. A few thousand addresses mean millions of pairs; forty thousand addresses mean eight hundred million; the road network for the whole city is ninety thousand stretches of road. Right: a small grid of junctions and roads, with one road closed. A search from A spreads out in order of distance, and stops when it reaches B, having explored only the junctions nearer than B; the shortest route avoids the closed road.
svg.text: Every pair of addresses, or the roads between junctions
Logarithmic scale: each step is a thousand times more.
Explore outward in order of distance; stop at B
Ruth's numbers on the left; the grid is illustrative. Her city had about ninety thousand stretches of road, and a query explored a few thousand.
